name: Template C: Extension of Approval with Substantive Changes
aphSourceReference: Approval Process Handbook 2024–2027 Chapter II, Clauses 2.5 to 2.14 & Table 2.3
description: Approval workflow for existing institutions applying for substantive alterations: Intake Increase, Introduction of New Program/Course, Change of Site, Division Addition, or Change of Name. Governed dynamically by Table 2.3 provisions.
statutoryConstraints: Table 2.3 Row 4 mandates physical EVC for Change of Site / Location
Table 2.3 Row 3 mandates Scrutiny for Intake Increase, and EVC if institution lacks NBA accreditation
New courses in emerging technologies requires curriculum concurrence from affiliating university
Deficiencies not cleared in re-scrutiny automatically route to Standing Hearing Committee (SHC)
